body:
# 🛠️ Panadero Repair Stations

A repair station that behaves like an anvil, looks like an anvil, but doesn't need XP. It just wants your diamonds.

This mod adds a repair station block for Minecraft that allows you to repair tools and items using a custom currency (by default, diamonds), without relying on XP or traditional anvils.

> Yes, it says **stations**, give me a break.

---

## ✨ Features

* 🔧 Repair items using materials instead of experience
* ⚙️ Fully configurable (cost, currency, break chance)
* 💥 Degrades over time and can break (like an anvil)
* 🎨 Visual state (chipped / damaged)
* 📊 Durability feedback with colored bars and percentages
* 🔊 Sound feedback based on condition
* ✨ Particles on use and destruction
* 🧾 Tooltip showing condition

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

Use in-game commands (OP only):

```
/repairstation config show
/repairstation config item <item>
/repairstation config maxcost <value>
/repairstation config breakchance <0-100>
```

Examples:

```
/repairstation config item minecraft:emerald
/repairstation config maxcost 50
/repairstation config breakchance 15
```

---

## 🎮 How it works

* Hold a damageable item
* Right-click the repair station
* The station consumes items from your inventory
* Repairs proportionally depending on how many items you have (up to max cost)

The station may degrade or break after use depending on configuration.

---
